summary: Completed testing of Add Orders to Existing Trip feature. Backend: 12/12 tests passed. Frontend: All UI components verified - 'В рейс' button, AddToTripModal, trip selection dropdown all working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Test trips and orders created and cleaned up during testing

add_orders_to_trip_endpoint.details: POST /api/trips/{trip_id}/add-orders correctly adds orders to existing trip, stores trip data in each order, and returns success response.

trip_data_stored_in_orders.details: Each order gets all trip fields: tripId, tripName, tripDriverId, tripDriverName, tripDepartureDate, tripStatus, tripOrderStatus. Data syncs when trip is updated.

order_conflict_validation.details: Backend correctly rejects adding orders that are already in another trip with 400 status code.

v_reis_button.details: 'В рейс' button appears in OrdersListCard when orders are selected AND active trips (planned/in_transit) exist. Uses data-testid='add-to-trip-btn'.

add_to_trip_modal.details: AddToTripModal shows trip selection dropdown with only 'planned' or 'in_transit' status trips. Shows trip name, status badge, and order count.

data_refresh_after_add.details: After adding orders to trip, orders list refreshes correctly showing remaining unassigned orders. Trip details show updated order count.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Add Orders to Existing Trip feature is complete. Test file /app/tests/test_add_orders_to_trip.py covers all backend scenarios. Frontend 'В рейс' button and AddToTripModal work correctly.
